articles.summary: Ty Sydnor is a Contracts Manager with Oceaneering Space Systems (OSS) in Houston, TX. His role centers on leading the negotiation, strategy, and administration of a broad portfolio of government contracts, including Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ; Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF); Firm Fixed Price (FFP); and Time and Materials (T&M) agreements.
